summary: 75-year-old hiker found by another hiker the evening of July 25 below Willow Lake, blue, soaking wet, severely hypothermic, dehydrated with severe lower-body cramping after a monsoon storm; the reporting party sheltered him overnight; 7 AVSAR + 1 SAGSAR members deployed Sunday morning, made contact before 11 a.m.; the hiker completed the entire trail with minimal assistance and declined further treatment.
location: Willow Lake trail, below Willow Lake, Sangre de Cristo Range
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue (AVSAR); Saguache County Search and Rescue (SAGSAR)
notes: Row dated the SAR mission day 2026-07-26 (Sunday-verified): found by another hiker evening of Sat 2026-07-25, SAR deployed Sun morning 2026-07-26, contact before 11 a.m. Mutual-aid mission (SAGSAR requested AVSAR help for the carryout). Inserted per run-663 refinement (predates freshness-sweep windows, fully verified).
